Before I call this done — my last turn was a claim, not a verified result, and "looks right to me" is being asked of a file neither of us has re-read since I overwrote it blind. Checking the artifacts first.

TOOL: git status --short && git diff --stat
TOOL: sed -n '1,120p' utils/dates.py
TOOL: sed -n '1,120p' tests/test_dates.py
TOOL: python -m pytest tests/test_dates.py -q

Three things I need to see before proposing closure: that `write_file` didn't clobber parsers that were already in `utils/dates.py` (I never read it first — that's the reckless part of the last turn), that the error message actually names the value that failed, and that the test passes rather than just looking plausible.
